sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United face a local derby against bottom-placed Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to avenge a recent cup defeat to the same opponents that went to penalties. The Bach then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October. With Sandbach currently top of the table on 22 points, they'll be keen to maintain their position despite their most recent league result being a loss.
divisionWide: Several key fixtures shape the weekend: second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday 3 October in what will be their first-ever trip to the ground, while AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two of the division's stronger performers. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in an important derby encounter. The midtable battle continues with Bilston Town hosting Foley Meir, and Barnton facing Shawbury United (who are in poor form with six consecutive losses). On the Wednesday, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community before facing Allscott Heath on Saturday, with the Heath looking to maintain their recent form. In a concerning trend for the bottom end, Widnes Town visit Market Drayton Town, while New Mills host Telford Town and Crewe travel to face Allscott Heath on Saturday 3 October. By Saturday 10 October, Bilston Town host Crewe, Telford Town visit New Mills, and Stafford Town host Wednesfield Community as the fixture list continues its cycle.
